name: Mech heron
notes: Origin on the ground between the feet, face +Z, up +Y, about 12 m tall. Joints walk -1...1 (hips 24 deg, positive swings the right leg back, shins counter-bend 14 deg), neck -1...1 (six chained segments, -1 coils back, +1 strikes down and forward to the waterline; rest is the midpoint, standing pose about -0.5), beak 0...1 (lower blade 30 deg), wings 0...1 (panel wings swing up and out 100 deg about Z), glow 0...1 are empty drivers; child parts mimic them. Follower lamps switches option at glow 0.05 (cyan eye strip, cyan point light).
parts: lofted gunmetal body, 48 stations by 64 radial points, under glossy white ceramic armour panels, breast plate, tail blade fan
two chrome hydraulic piston legs (48 radial tubes) with ceramic thigh shells, twin pistons, backward knees, hoses
six-segment chrome S-neck with ceramic collars and twin piston rods
ceramic head with a cyan LED eye strip and a stainless blade beak with hinged lower blade
two folding wings of overlapping ceramic and chrome panels on chrome spars
jump-jet nozzles under the wing roots
style: Original design robotic heron: glossy white ceramic and mirror chrome, gunmetal joints, hydraulic pistons, blade beak, cyan LED eye. Clean industrial robot look.
summary: 12 m mech heron: chrome and white ceramic panels, hydraulic piston legs with backward knees, six-segment S-neck, blade beak, LED eye strip, folding panel wings.
